item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 29 September 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Ragay, Lupi, Calabanga, Bombon, Magarao, NagaCity, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Presentacion, Lagonoy), #Albay(PioDuran, Guinobatan, Jovellar), #Sorsogon(Bulan, Pilar, Donsol, Irosin, Matnog), #NorthernSamar(Bobon, SanJose, Victoria, SanIsidro, Rosario, Lavezares, Allen), #Romblon(Cajidiocan, SanFernando and Magdiwang) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Mandaon, Milagros, Balud), #OrientalMindoro(Mansalay, Bongabong and Roxas) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
